page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred lines; a woodcut device in the middle; library stamps and show-through at the right and left (not transcribed).
page.notes: The stamps ("BIBLIOTECA NAZ... ROMA", "VITTORIO EMANUELE") and the show-through of the reverse page are not transcribed. The woodcut device is an ornament without text. Handwritten "Dom. Prof. Rom." is in script, but it is printed as part of the title page and is transcribed as the last line. Printed "Dom. Prof. Rom." may be handwriting; the printed date reads CIↃ IↃC LXXVI, i.e. MDCLXXVI. The "Digitized by Google" banner is excluded.
